Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a single game GUI SPRITE ATLAS, 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 equal square cells, square canvas 2048x2048. Transparent background with real alpha. Every sprite centered fully INSIDE its own cell with 40 px transparent margin, absolutely no overlap. Cute premium casual Korean artillery tank game, inspired by the playful illustrated game-feel of classic Fortress 2, original artwork. Rich hand-painted 2.5D cartoon enamel, chubby inflated bevels, bold smooth navy outline, cream edge trim, saturated sky-blue, turquoise and orange, pleasing glossy highlights, warm friendly toy materials. Orthographic FRONT view. NO TEXT NO LETTERS NO NUMBERS NO LABELS NO GRID LINES. 
Exact order left to right:
Row 1: (1) rounded-square UI panel, thick cream outer rim, turquoise narrow inner bevel and perfectly plain uniform deep navy interior taking 80% of area for readable live text, small decorative corner screws only; (2) rounded-square glossy azure blue button with cream edge and plain blue center; (3) rounded-square glossy golden-orange selected button with cream edge and plain warm orange center; (4) rounded-square dark navy inset inventory slot with plump light-blue rim and plain center.
Row 2: (1) circular character portrait frame cream and skyblue with EMPTY transparent inner circle, (2) circular ANGLE dial, cream chunky rim and dark navy dial face, simple radial tick marks but NO numbers NO needle, (3) long horizontal empty gauge trough centered in cell, rounded capsule navy cavity and cream trim, (4) golden victory star badge with blue ribbon, no lettering.
Row 3: (1) cute chunky silver artillery shell with orange tip, (2) cute cyan guided rocket with orange fins, (3) golden energy star and cyan swoosh, (4) red-and-white first aid kit with white plus.
Row 4: (1) lightblue settings gear, (2) white and cyan wind swirl, (3) orange circular aiming reticle, (4) mint-green wheel with motion streaks.
All elements cleanly isolated with real transparency, strong reusable silhouettes. No tanks, no background scene, no captions. Panels must be simple untextured interiors suitable for 9-slice scaling. Polished shipped-game GUI quality, not wireframes.
title: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished wide 16:9 title-screen background illustration for TANKFALL, a cute casual tank artillery videogame. No text, no letters, no logo, no UI. Premium colorful hand-painted 3D cartoon illustration, rounded toy materials and thick clean shapes, nostalgic cheerful Korean Fortress 2 character charm, modern polished casual game key art. Bright cerulean sky, fluffy clouds, emerald floating grassy island cliffs, distant turquoise sea, a few tiny flying shells tracing playful arcs. Left foreground a big adorable tangerine-orange chibi tank with ivory trim, enormous friendly oval eyes integrated into front hull, very round capsule turret, short chunky barrel, chunky dark rubber tracks and 3 large wheels, smiles. Behind it a cute violet orb-coil hover tank with glossy cyan rings. Right foreground an adorable mint-blue rounded rocket truck with nine chunky launch ports, expressive eyes and plump tires. Smaller lime-green winged hover tank beside it. Tanks should have substantial sculpted detail and pleasing materials, not cubes. Composition frames the empty central 35% of canvas reserved for title/menu: tanks occupy lower-left and lower-right corners, clear soft blue sky across the entire upper half, grassy clear center. Sunlit joyful adventurous mood, subtle shadows, painterly polish, crisp game concept art, absolutely no realistic military violence, no humans.
